```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)

source(here::here("code/find_many_similar.R"))
source(here::here("code/read_annotated_vcf.R"))
source(here::here("code/annot_vcf_to_476_catalog.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: read-data

spectra <- read.delim(
  here::here("Manuscript_data/Liu_et_al_476_type_spectra.tsv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

sigs <- read.delim(
  here::here("Manuscript_data/Liu_et_al_final_476_type_signatures.tsv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

## Find spectra similar to `r params$sig_to_report`

```{r}
#| label: find-similar

similar_spectra <- find_many_similar(
  sig_path = here::here(
    "Manuscript_data/Liu_et_al_final_476_type_signatures.tsv"
  ),
  sig_col = params$sig_to_report,
  spectra_path = here::here("Manuscript_data/Liu_et_al_476_type_spectra.tsv"),
  cosine_cutoff = 0.9,
  num_exemplars = 10,
  min_mutations = 50,
  out_pdf = here::here(
    "msi_study",
    paste0("exemplars_for_", params$sig_to_report, ".pdf")
  )
)
```

### Exemplar spectra plots

```{r}
#| label: plot-exemplars
#| fig-height: 3
#| results: asis

for (p in similar_spectra$plots) {
  print(p)
}
```

## Validate computed spectra vs file spectra

```{r}
#| label: validate-spectra

annot_vcf_list <- list()

for (raw_id in similar_spectra$top_exemplars$spectrum) {
  # find_many_similar uses check.names=TRUE so :: becomes ..
  id <- gsub("\\.\\.", "::", raw_id)
  cat("## Processing ", id)
  result <- tryCatch(
    {
      vcf <- read_annotated_vcf(id)
      FILTER_PASS = !grepl("::SP", id)
      computed_spectrum <- annot_vcf_to_476_catalog(
        vcf,
        'computed_spectrum',
        FILTER_PASS = FILTER_PASS
      )$computed_spectrum

      file_spectrum <- spectra[, id]

      computed_total <- sum(computed_spectrum)
      file_total <- sum(file_spectrum)
      abs_diff <- sum(abs(computed_spectrum - file_spectrum))
      cos_sim <- lsa::cosine(computed_spectrum, file_spectrum)[1, 1]

      cat(sprintf(
        "**%s**: computed=%d, file=%d, abs_diff=%.1f, cosine=%.6f\n\n",
        id,
        computed_total,
        file_total,
        abs_diff,
        cos_sim
      ))

      annot_vcf_list[[id]] <- vcf
    },
    error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("**%s**: skipped (%s)\n\n", id, e$message))
      NULL
    }
  )
}

annot_vcf <- rbindlist(annot_vcf_list, fill = TRUE)
cat(sprintf(
  "\nCombined VCF: %d rows from %d samples\n",
  nrow(annot_vcf),
  length(annot_vcf_list)
))
has_vcf_data <- nrow(annot_vcf) > 0
if (!has_vcf_data) {
  warning("No annotated VCFs could be read; skipping downstream sections")
}
```

## Poly-T and Poly-C tract length distributions for `r params$sig_to_report`

```{r}
#| label: tract-lengths
#| fig-height: 4
#| eval: !expr has_vcf_data

patterns <- c(
  "Del\\(T" = "Del(T)",
  "Ins\\(T" = "Ins(T)",
  "Del\\(C" = "Del(C)",
  "Ins\\(C" = "Ins(C)"
)

for (i in seq_along(patterns)) {
  pat <- names(patterns)[i]
  label <- patterns[i]

  counts <- annot_vcf |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl(pat, Koh_476)) |>
    dplyr::count(R_outside_ins_or_del_seq) |>
    dplyr::mutate(repeat_count = 1 + R_outside_ins_or_del_seq)

  if (nrow(counts) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\nNo mutations found.\n\n", label))
    next
  }

  cat(sprintf(
    "\n### %s\n\nMean: %.2f, Median: %.1f, SD: %.2f\n\n",
    label,
    weighted.mean(counts$repeat_count, counts$n),
    median(rep(counts$repeat_count, counts$n)),
    sd(rep(counts$repeat_count, counts$n))
  ))

  p <- ggplot(counts, aes(x = repeat_count, weight = n)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
    labs(
      title = paste(label, "repeat count distribution"),
      x = "Repeat count",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)
}
```

## Investigate types of interest `r params$sig_to_report`

```{r}
#| label: types-of-interest
#| fig-height: 4
#| eval: !expr has_vcf_data

for (indel_type in params$types_of_interest) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", indel_type))

  summary_of_type <- annot_vcf |>
    dplyr::filter(Koh_476 == indel_type) |>
    dplyr::count(ins_or_del_seq, R_outside_ins_or_del_seq, short_visual) |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(n))

  if (nrow(summary_of_type) == 0) {
    cat("No mutations found for this type.\n\n")
    next
  }

  print(kable(summary_of_type))
  cat("\n\n")

  plot_data <- head(summary_of_type, 20)
  plot_data$short_visual <- factor(
    plot_data$short_visual,
    levels = rev(unique(plot_data$short_visual))
  )
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = n, y = short_visual)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Top contexts for", indel_type),
      x = "Count",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
